Class AdminListingFormDialog

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.control.Dialog<Listing>
com.hkust.marketplace.controllers.admin.AdminListingFormDialog
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.event.EventTarget
final class AdminListingFormDialog extends javafx.scene.control.Dialog<Listing>
Task 3.7 – Add / edit listing form used by the admin.

Mirrors the seller Create New Listing fields (type first, then item name, category, condition, description, price or lending duration, meet-up location and up to six photos). New admin-created listings start as Pending Review, exactly like seller submissions; edits keep the listing's current status.
